f2.what: P2 (the operator's 'Proceed the plan', 2026-11-09): instance agreement. Lean evaluates the CANONICAL statement's own components (its instance binders become parameters, each hypothesis and the conclusion a `decide`, nothing restated) on every instance below; an independent exact decider written here from the INFORMAL statement only (instruments/intake/erdos-488.js, no Lean, no DeepMind code read) evaluates the same instances; the two must agree wherever the informal statement is defined. The canonical statement's values are confirmed by the kernel (decide +kernel, in chunks). Pre-registered here before any F2 code runs.
f2.informal: erdosproblems.com/488 as DeepMind's docstring quotes it: Let A be a finite set and B = {n ≥ 1 : a ∣ n for some a ∈ A}. Is it true that, for every m > n ≥ max(A), |B ∩ [1,m]|/m < 2|B ∩ [1,n]|/n?
